subject: Web Development
title: ASP and Server-Side Microsoft
description: One-minute skill: ASP and Server-Side Microsoft.

hook.text: Microsoft wanted enterprise developers building on the web. ASP was their answer.

buildup.text: Active Server Pages let developers write server code in VBScript embedded in HTML.

discovery.text: Corporate IT departments adopted ASP because it integrated with existing Microsoft tools.

twist.text: ASP only ran on Windows servers. This vendor lock-in would haunt Microsoft for years.

climax.text: ASP.NET replaced it with a more structured model that still powers enterprise apps today.

punchline.text: Enterprise web development started in Microsoft's world.
